name: Favorite Sweet!
source:
The protagonist’s relatives are leaving overseas and plan to close up the cafe they work at. He decides to try to be the new owner himself. But the patissiere who works there is a tsuntsun girl who had dumped him at school. She tells him that if he doesn’t do a good job and sell all the sweets that she makes, then she will quit. He’s now not sure if this will go as smoothly as he thought it would.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
主人公的亲戚即将移居海外，并打算关闭他们经营的咖啡厅。他决定尝试亲自接手，成为新店主。然而店里的糕点师，正是那个曾在学校拒绝过他的傲娇女孩。她告诉他，如果他不能好好经营、卖光她制作的所有甜点，她就会辞职。如今，他开始怀疑事情是否真能像自己原先想的那样顺利。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
